provenance.task: T1, the 2026-07-30 weapon-relative movement shared foundation task list
provenance.purpose: Per-tick trajectory digest for seed 1 at 200 agents under PersistentContingentsV4, captured from the completely unmodified src/ tree at commit af2a0a1, before any weapon-relative-movement code exists. Every later task in that plan that could plausibly disturb PersistentContingentsV4's trajectory reproduces this fixture byte-identically as part of its own verification.
provenance.eventFoldSpecification: Per tick, start at the canonical FNV-1a 64-bit offset basis 14695981039346656037 and fold, for each event of that tick in emission order, the twelve words HeadlessRunner.AddEventToHash folds: (ulong)Sequence, (ulong)Tick, (ulong)Kind, SourceEntityId, TargetEntityId ?? 0, (ulong)(uint)Value, FactionId is int f ? (ulong)(uint)f : ulong.MaxValue, Weapon is WeaponId w ? (ulong)(uint)(int)w : ulong.MaxValue, Shield is ShieldId s ? (ulong)(uint)(int)s : ulong.MaxValue, HitLocation is BodyPart h ? (ulong)(uint)(int)h : ulong.MaxValue, Resolution is AttackResolution r ? (ulong)(uint)(int)r : ulong.MaxValue, ComboPosition is int p ? (ulong)(uint)p : ulong.MaxValue. This is the same fold the headless runner and the benchmark script use to report eventHash, so this fixture's per-tick eventFold column is directly comparable to that output at the same tick.
provenance.stateHashSpecification: The parameterless BattleSimulation.ComputeStateHash() taken immediately after each AdvanceOneTick().
provenance.harnessDisposition: The harness was a temporary xunit fact in tests/Hukbo.Core.Tests, deleted after this file was written.
provenance.schemaNote: The finalAgents rows carry real values for contingentId and contingentState: PersistentContingentsV4 populates both AgentState.ContingentId and AgentState.ContingentState, unlike the frozen IndependentPursuitV1 fixture, which reserves both columns as 0.

scenario.construction: Scenario.CreateDefault(1, 200) with MovementPreset = MovementPresetId.PersistentContingentsV4, BodyRadiusRaw = 4 * FixedPoint.Scale, and CombatPreset = CombatPresetId.PrecolonialPhilippinesV2, then BattleSimulation.Create(scenario). The body radius and combat preset are pinned explicitly because the shipped defaults for both have moved since the V1/V2 fixtures were captured; these values match the ones those fixtures inherited implicitly.
